expeditions.title: Eclipse Watch
expeditions.description: Astris needs help logging an eclipse. Two readings have to be taken at the right moment or the data is lost.

steps.narrative: Astris hands you a logbook. "Stand by the smaller scope. When I call totality, write what you see."

choices.label: Ready your pen and watch the sky.

steps.narrative: The disc darkens. Astris's voice cracks — "Now!" — and the corona blooms.

choices.label: Capture the corona description in full sentences.
Scribble bullet points — speed over detail.
Stare at the corona, forgetting to write.
